title: KiwiSMP
description: Join KiwiSMP's EarthSMP, where you can explore and build on a 1:500 scale map of the real world. Create your civilization, conquer famous landmarks, and participate in unique community events!
body:
🥝 **KiwiSMP — Minecraft Earth SMP with Java + Bedrock Crossplay** 🌍

Step into **KiwiSMP**, a Minecraft multiplayer server founded in 2021 and approaching its 5th anniversary as one of the longest-running Earth SMPs in the world! 🏆 Full **Java + Bedrock crossplay** on version **26.1**. ⚡

🎮 **IP:** `play.kiwismp.fun` *(Java & Bedrock)*

---

🗺️ **Four Gamemodes Under One Network:**

🌐 **Earth SMP** — Claim land on a scale replica of Earth, form clans, wage country wars, and conquer the globe! Epic battles featured on our TikTok. ⚔️

🟩 **OneBlock SMP** — Relax, build, and create in our peaceful, friendly OneBlock world. Perfect for chill vibes. 🌱

❤️ **Lifesteal** — *Newly released!* Hearts on the line in our brutal PvP gamemode. 💀

🎉 **Event Server** — Every weekend, the community votes for two thrilling events! Split or Steal, Hunger Games, and more! 🗳️

---

✨ **Why Players Choose KiwiSMP:**

🔥 **40,000+ Discord members** — one of the largest Earth SMP communities on the planet
🎮 **Java + Bedrock crossplay** — rare for Earth SMPs (most are Java only!)
📅 **5 years of continuous operation** since 2021
⭐ **Featured by content creators** including **MrBeast**, **DrDonut**, and **RopoMC**
💚 **Free to play** — no whitelist, no pay-to-win
🛡️ **Active moderation** and weekly community events
🌎 **Live web map** showing real-time nations and claims

---

🚀 **Ready to join the adventure?**

🎯 **Server IP:** `play.kiwismp.fun`
💬 **Discord:** discord.gg/kiwismp *(40k+ members!)*
🗺️ **Live Map:** earth.kiwismp.fun
📱 **TikTok:** @kiwiismp

**See you on the server!** 🥝🌍⚔️
